content:
The image shows a mango leaf with dark, irregular/oval-shaped spots scattered across the leaf surface. The spots appear dark brown to black, sunken, and irregular in shape. The rest of the leaf is green and healthy-looking.

Key observations:
- Dark, irregular-shaped spots on the leaf surface
- Spots appear sunken/depressed
- Spots are oval to irregular in shape
- Located across the leaf (not confined to margins)

This matches Anthracnose description: "Oval or irregular brown to deep brown sunken spots on leaves, most prominently on young leaves" and "Irregular, oval-shaped spots all over the leaf surface."

The spots do not match:
- Sooty Mould (would be black soot-like coating over large surface area)
- Powdery Mildew (white powdery coating)
- Die_Back (bark discoloration, gum secretion, twig withering)
